skeleton._comment: Task 2.3: the Horns' camp, attached to ruin_surface's `ceria_dig_camp` NPC. A SEPARATE graph file, not nodes inside ceria_intro.json: a graph is one file (game.gd keys dialogue_graphs by basename) and always opens at its own `start`, with no per-entity start-node override, so camp_hub could never be reached through ceria_intro's hub. The split is also what the place-naming validator wants -- the horns_dig GIVER maps stay disjoint from the join_dig PRODUCER map. SPOILER RULE: no line here names a door; the reveal is the pedestal's open_toast. NO door_retrieved arm lives here: the camp survives the whole haul window, so a past-tense arm would be wrong while the haul is still running; spec 8's past-tense arm stays on ceria_intro's hub.
